/** * Binary operator that returns DISCARD if either operand is DISCARD, otherwise PASS. * This implements an "any discarded" logic for combining two policies. * *

diff.line_above: public static final BinaryOperator ANY_DISCARDED = (a, b) -> a == MessagePolicy.DISCARD || b == MessagePolicy.DISCARD ? MessagePolicy.DISCARD : MessagePolicy.PASS;
